title: Mock backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the hardware-free mock provider. The mock fakes inference: no real engine, no downloads. Sections mirror the canonical layout used by real providers (Phase 12).

artifacts.title: Model files
artifacts.description: Artifact descriptors. The mock accepts them but never downloads; they exist for UI/form consistency.

model.title: Main model
model.description: Fake model artifact descriptor (hf-file widget). Unused by the mock engine.

ctx.title: Context size
ctx.description: Context window tokens (fake; recorded by the driver).

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature (fake; recorded by the driver).

top_k.title: Top-k
top_k.description: Top-k sampling cutoff (fake; recorded by the driver).

top_p.title: Top-p
top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability (fake; recorded by the driver).

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: RNG seed; -1 = random (fake; recorded by the driver).

stream.title: Mock stream
stream.description: The mock's real behavioral knobs: the canned token stream shape.

delta_count.title: Delta count
delta_count.description: Number of output_text deltas emitted per response.

delta_delay.title: Delta delay (s)
delta_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between emitted deltas.

backend_port.title: Backend port
backend_port.description: Port the fake backend would listen on (recorded; the mock has no subprocess).

audio.title: Mock audio
audio.description: Phase 24: behavioral knobs for the mock's fake speech/transcription surface (no real engine).

sample_rate.title: Sample rate (Hz)
sample_rate.description: Sine-wave sample rate for fake speech output.

duration_seconds.title: Duration (s)
duration_seconds.description: Length of the generated sine wave.

pcm_chunk_count.title: PCM chunk count
pcm_chunk_count.description: Number of chunks a response_format=pcm stream is split into.

pcm_chunk_delay.title: PCM chunk delay (s)
pcm_chunk_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between emitted PCM chunks.
